_comment: Project-level MCP config for Henri. Added 2026-04-22 + expanded 2026-04-29
post-launch. Each server below requires an env-sourced secret — paste
the matching key into .env.local (already gitignored) and restart Claude
Once live, these servers give Claude:
- supabase  → apply_migration, execute_sql, list_tables, RLS mgmt
- resend    → send feedback/outreach/invoice emails from templates
- playwright→ deterministic browser automation for contractor-side QA
- sentry    → query errors, manage releases, alert mgmt (post-DSN)
- stripe    → create products, configure webhooks, query subs
- github    → repo ops, PRs, issues, releases
- fetch     → generic HTTP for one-off API probes
Secrets NEVER live here. .mcp.json IS committed to git (project shape
is part of the repo), but every `env` line references a process
variable that the user sets outside the repo (in .env.local, locally,
and in Vercel env vars at deploy time).

sentry._comment: Activates once SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is set. Get a User Auth Token at https://sentry.io/settings/account/api/auth-tokens/ with scopes: project:read, event:read, project:releases.

stripe._comment: Activates once STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set in .env.local. Use a restricted key (Products + Webhooks scope) for safer automation, or the full secret key (sk_live_) if you want all surfaces.

github._comment: Activates once GITHUB_TOKEN is set. Generate a fine-grained token at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens with read+write on the henri-app repo only.
